title: Construct dynamical and peak-corrected nulls
frozenQuestion: How much of the observed composition-corrected aggregation peak and persistence remains after comparison with exchangeable null maxima from temporally coherent trajectory surrogates?

scope.progressDefinition: floor(progress * final accepted swaps), progress 0.00 through 1.00
scope.metric: paper-denominator adjacency minus the validated S02 exact-composition expectation

nullFamilies.randomization: uniformly permute immutable policy labels across all 100 identity trajectories once per draw and carry the permuted labels through the complete observed identity-occupancy trajectory
preserves: positions and values at every grid point
nullFamilies.estimand: total dynamical label organization, including organization mediated by value or mobility

nullFamilies.exchangeabilityUnit: cell identity within frozen value stratum
nullFamilies.randomization: permute immutable policy labels within exact values for repeated inputs or fixed value deciles for unique inputs, then carry labels through observed identity trajectories
preserves: policy counts within frozen value strata
nullFamilies.estimand: dynamical organization beyond the preserved resolution of policy-value association
nullFamilies.warning: This can over-condition away a policy-value pathway; exact-value conditioning for unique inputs is degenerate and is not used confirmatorily.

nullFamilies.exchangeabilityUnit: cell identity within frozen trajectory-mobility quintile
nullFamilies.mobilityDescriptor: lexicographic rank of grid-resolved cumulative absolute displacement, number of grid intervals moved, and identity index; five equal-size strata of 20 identities
nullFamilies.randomization: uniformly permute immutable policy labels within each mobility quintile and carry labels through observed identity trajectories
nullFamilies.estimand: dynamical organization beyond coarse observed mobility association
nullFamilies.warning: Mobility is post-treatment and can be part of the mechanism, so this is a sensitivity null rather than an automatically superior baseline.

nullFamilies.randomization: draw one uniform position permutation per trajectory and conjugate every observed grid-to-grid unlabeled transport permutation by that same position permutation; apply the conjugated operator sequence to the observed initial policy-label arrangement
preserves: chronological sequence and algebra of unlabeled transport permutations
cycle structure and moved-identity fraction of every interval
breaks: alignment between policy labels and the spatial placement of each transport operator
value-guided geometric placement after the initial state
nullFamilies.estimand: organization generated by policy-independent placement of the same unlabeled transport chronology
nullFamilies.warning: This is a descriptor-preserving surrogate, not a rerun of a newly invented neutral sorting policy; it does not preserve swap distance in the original open-path geometry.

outcomes.peak: maximum of the 101-point condition-mean corrected trajectory
outcomes.duration: Lebesgue fraction of normalized progress where the piecewise-linear corrected trajectory is above zero, with exact linear crossing interpolation
outcomes.positiveArea: integral of the positive part of the piecewise-linear corrected trajectory over normalized progress
outcomes.peakAdjustedEffect: observed peak minus the reference-null mean of trajectory maxima
outcomes.effectInterval: observed statistic minus the 97.5th and 2.5th percentiles of the reference-null statistic

multiplicity.primary: Benjamini-Hochberg across 186 conditions separately within null family and outcome
multiplicity.sensitivity: Benjamini-Hochberg across all null-family, outcome, and condition tests
multiplicity.withinTrajectory: comparison with null maxima, duration, or area computed from complete trajectories; no pointwise p-value is selected

calibration.pooling: 186 conditions separately by null family and outcome
calibration.randomizedTieRule: uniform randomized rank within the complete reference-plus-pseudo-observation tie block
calibration.tolerance: absolute randomized false-positive deviation <= max(0.015, 5 * binomial standard error); conservative rate <= alpha plus the same tolerance

temporalValidation.labelAndMobilityFamilies: observed occupancy and full transport chronology are retained exactly
temporalValidation.policyNeutralFamily: each interval operator is a fixed-permutation conjugate, so cycle sizes, fixed-point counts, moved fraction, and the moved-fraction lag-1 and lag-5 autocorrelations are exact

primaryAnchors.population: balanced 50/50 pairwise, absent policy-value association, both unique and repeated inputs
primaryAnchors.peakPass: at least 4 of 6 have label_permuted_global peak BH q <= 0.05 and peak-adjusted effect > 0.02
primaryAnchors.persistencePass: at least 4 of 6 have label_permuted_global BH q <= 0.05 for duration or positive area
primaryAnchors.selectionInflationPass: mean null maximum exceeds the maximum of the pointwise null-mean trajectory by more than 1e-6 in at least 95% of global-label conditions

completionCriteria: all 4650 frozen scenarios replay exactly and all 469650 selected S04 grid states match
all 380928 group null trajectories are accounted for
zero sufficient-statistic, trajectory-length, transport-preservation, or deterministic-pairing violations
multiplicity-adjusted peak and persistence effects are written
the primary peak, persistence, and selection-inflation anchors pass for a supportive outcome
claimBoundaries: A maximum-corrected spatial statistic is not evidence of biological adhesion, affinity, cognition, intention, or an attractor.
Value- and mobility-conditioned nulls answer narrower questions and can condition away the mechanism.
The policy-neutral transport null preserves observed transport descriptors but is not a counterfactual neutral sorting algorithm.
S06 does not equalize policy kinetics or execute S07.
